fieldData.description: To celebrate 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, come share drinks & food with your fellow Vietnamese community members and chat about crypto, DeFi, and of course RadixDLT! This event will be very casual and welcoming. Anyone who wants to make friends and learn about DeFi is welcome. Free food, drinks and T-shirts for everyone. Feel free to reach out to @CodyPham on Telegram for any clarification and join the local community https://t.me/RadixVietnam
